DashboardCustody.byokInvalidCredentials: Privy rejected these credentials. Check the app ID and secret, then connect again.
DashboardCustody.byokAccountAlreadyConnected: This Privy app is already connected to a custody setup. Use a different app, then connect again.
DashboardCustody.byokWalletConflict: This connection is tied to a Privy wallet that cannot be reconciled. Replacing the credentials will not fix it; contact support to resolve the connection.
DashboardCustody.byokCheckFailed: Verification did not complete. Connect again to retry.
DashboardCustody.byokRetryUnknown: We could not confirm whether verification finished. Your credentials are stored; checking again is safe and will not create a duplicate.
DashboardCustody.byokMissingFields: Fill in every required credential field.
DashboardCustody.byokSubmitFailed: Storing the credential failed. Try again.
DashboardCustody.connectionsDescription: Custody connections your project set up from stored provider credentials.
DashboardCustody.connectionsEmptyDescription: Connect a custody provider with your own credentials to see it listed here.
DashboardCustody.connectionsLoadErrorDescription: Something went wrong reading this project's connections. Try again in a moment.
DashboardCustody.addConnectionDescription: Connect a Privy app to this project.
DashboardCustody.signingPausedTitle: Signing through your own credentials is currently not allowed for this organization.
DashboardCustody.signingPausedBody: Connections, wallets and history stay visible. You can still rotate, roll back and deactivate. New signing requests through these connections fail until it is allowed again. Nothing has been deleted.
DashboardCustody.readOnlyViewer: You can view connections in this project. Adding, rotating or deactivating needs the custody admin role. Ask an organization admin in Settings › Members.
DashboardCustody.setupUnfinishedBody: Verification did not complete. Checking again continues this setup and never creates a second connection.
DashboardCustody.connectionDeactivatedExplainer: This connection was deactivated and cannot be used for signing. Wallets and history are kept for reference. To use this account again, add a new connection.
DashboardCustody.walletsPendingSetup: No wallets yet. The first wallet is created when setup finishes.
DashboardCustody.credentialDeploymentExplainer: These credentials are set by your SDP operator in the deployment configuration. Rotate and roll back are not available here; changes are made in the deployment and take effect on restart.
DashboardCustody.credentialsRestricted: Your role can view this connection but not its credentials. Ask an organization admin for the custody admin role.
DashboardCustody.credentialsUnavailable: Credentials could not be loaded just now. The rest of this page is up to date; reload to try again.
DashboardCustody.rotateFailed: Privy rejected the new credentials. The current credentials remain in use; nothing changed.
DashboardCustody.rotateRetryHint: The result is unknown. Retry this rotation to confirm its outcome. Closing this dialog does not cancel the rotation.
DashboardCustody.rotateResumeHint: The rotation result is still unknown. Resume the rotation to check its outcome.
DashboardCustody.rotateUnknown: We couldn't confirm whether the rotation finished. Refresh to see the current version before retrying.
DashboardCustody.rotationPendingTitle: A rotation is waiting to finish.
DashboardCustody.rotationPendingBody: The current credentials are still in use. Checking again settles the replacement and never creates a second one; cancelling discards it.
DashboardCustody.rotationUnusedBody: The current credentials are no longer in use. A pending replacement must be cancelled separately.
DashboardCustody.rollbackTitle: Roll back to the previous credentials?
DashboardCustody.rollbackWindow: Available until {expiresAt} ({hours} h left). After that the previous secret is deleted and only a new rotation is possible.
DashboardCustody.rollbackBlockedByRotation: Cancel the waiting rotation before rolling back.
DashboardCustody.rollbackSuccessDescription: {count} connections returned to the previous credentials.
DashboardCustody.rollbackFailed: The previous credentials no longer pass verification. The current credentials remain in use.
DashboardCustody.deactivateConnectionSectionBody: Permanently stops this connection. History is kept.
DashboardCustody.deactivateConnectionBlockedBody: {count} wallets are still active on this connection. Privy wallets can't be deactivated from SDP yet, so this connection stays active.
DashboardCustody.deactivateConnectionBlockedExplainer: When it is possible: deactivation is permanent, keeps all history and wallet records, and does not revoke the App Secret at Privy — do that in your Privy dashboard if needed. It is also not the same as cancelling an unfinished setup.
DashboardCustody.deactivateConnectionExplainer: This connection stops permanently. The record and its history stay visible as Deactivated. To connect this account again later, add a new connection.
DashboardCustody.deactivateConnectionPointProviderKey: Does not revoke the App Secret at Privy.
DashboardCustody.deactivateBlockedByWallets: Unavailable while {count} wallets are active on this connection.
DashboardCustody.deactivateNotApplicableUnfinished: Not applicable: use Cancel setup above while setup is unfinished.
DashboardCustody.deactivateConnectionSuccessDescription: It stays listed as Deactivated with its history.
DashboardCustody.deactivateConnectionFailed: The connection could not be deactivated.
DashboardCustody.credentialsStillInUseBody: {count} connections reference these credentials, in {projects}. Deactivate or move those connections first.
DashboardCustody.deactivateCredentialsExplainer: Deactivation permanently disables these credentials in SDP and starts removing the stored secret. Use it when no connections reference these credentials. It does not revoke the key at Privy.
DashboardCustody.deactivateCredentialsSuccessDescription: These credentials can no longer be used for signing through SDP.
DashboardCustody.deactivateCredentialsFailed: The credentials could not be deactivated.
DashboardCustody.cancelSetupExplainer: Cancelling setup deactivates this connection. It stays listed as Deactivated. This does not revoke credentials with the provider. You can start again by adding a new connection.
DashboardCustody.cancelSetupFailed: The setup could not be cancelled.
DashboardCustody.addWalletHint: Created in this connection's Privy account. If the result is unknown, SDP will not retry automatically — check the wallet list before trying again.
DashboardCustody.addWalletSuccessDescription: It is listed on this connection.
DashboardCustody.addWalletFailed: The wallet could not be created.
DashboardCustody.outcomeInvalidBody: Check the app ID and secret, then connect again.
DashboardCustody.outcomeMismatchTitle: These credentials belong to a different Privy account.
DashboardCustody.outcomeMismatchBody: Rotation only replaces credentials for the same account, so existing wallets keep working. To use another account, add a new connection instead.
DashboardCustody.outcomeTemporaryTitle: Privy did not answer in time.
DashboardCustody.outcomeTemporaryBody: This is a connection problem, not a rejection. Your credentials are stored; checking again is safe and will not create a duplicate.
DashboardCustody.outcomeConflictTitle: This connection changed while you were working.
DashboardCustody.outcomeConflictBody: Someone else updated it. Nothing was applied. Reload to see the current state before trying again.
DashboardCustody.outcomeUnknownTitle: We could not confirm whether verification finished.
DashboardCustody.outcomeUnknownBody: Your credentials are stored; checking again is safe and will not create a duplicate.
DashboardCustody.outcomeWalletConflictTitle: This connection is tied to a Privy wallet that cannot be reconciled.
DashboardCustody.outcomeWalletConflictBody: Replacing the credentials will not fix it; contact support to resolve the connection.
DashboardCustody.walletSetupConnectionHint: The wallet is created in this account and signs with its credentials.
DashboardCustody.walletSetupConnectionRequired: Choose the account the wallet is created in.
DashboardCustody.walletSetupProviderAlreadySetUp: This provider is already set up. Add a wallet instead.
DashboardCustody.walletSetupModeHint: Managed wallets use SDP's provider account. Bring your own credentials connects your own provider app.
DashboardCustody.apiKeyAccessDescription: Choose which wallets this key can use and which operations it can perform.
DashboardCustody.apiKeyOperationsDescription: Limit the kinds of operations this key can perform. This applies to every wallet the key can use.
DashboardCustody.apiKeyOperationsAllHelper: No limit. The key can perform any operation its endpoint permissions allow.
DashboardCustody.apiKeyOperationsSelectedHelper: Anything you do not select is refused.
DashboardCustody.apiKeyOperationsRequired: Select at least one operation, or allow all operations.
DashboardCustody.apiKeyFamilyPaymentDescription: Transfers, transfer batches and recurring payments.
DashboardCustody.apiKeyFamilyIssuanceDescription: Deploy, mint, burn, freeze, pause and other token actions.
DashboardCustody.apiKeyFamilyProgramDescription: Earn deposits and withdrawals, and DvP funding and settlement.
DashboardCustody.apiKeyPermissionsSeparateFromOperations: Endpoint permissions determine reach. Allowed operations, set on the next step, can limit the key further.
